_comment: A linking book someone left behind. Rarer than pages by design -- a page is a word, this is a way
home, and finding one should change what you dare to do next.
stray_chance is the knob: 0 means every found book leads to the Overworld spawn, 1 means every one
leads to wherever it was found. A small fraction is the interesting setting -- most are the way
home, a few are somebody else's route to a place you have never been.
